title: Observational Study of Approaches to Lipid-Lowering Therapy in Russian Patients With Coronary Heart Disease <<Treat to Goal>> (Study P05464)
brief_summary: This study is being performed to evaluate what variants of lipid-lowering therapy are used in Russian clinical practice in coronary heart disease (CHD) patients with hypercholesterolemia in whom the initial statin therapy did not achieve low density lipoprotein-cholesterol (LDL-C) goals. Additionally, the efficacy and safety of all variants of modified lipid-lowering therapy are to be evaluated.
study_population: Patients with established diagnosis of coronary heart disease (CHD) and hypercholesterolemia who did not achieve the target values for total cholesterol (TC) and low density lipoprotein-C (LDL-C) with existing statin therapy
